FAQ.title: Everything you need to know.
FAQ.subtitle: Got questions about working together, pricing, or templates? Here are the answers.
FAQ.ctaSubtitle: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Feel free to reach out directly.

items.q: How does working with a solo developer compare to an agency?
items.a: You communicate directly with me — the engineer writing your code. No account managers, no hidden handoffs, faster response times, and lower overhead passed on to you.

items.q: How long does a typical project take from start to finish?
items.a: Template customizations are typically ready in 1 to 2 weeks. Custom web development and dynamic web applications generally take 3 to 6 weeks, depending on feature complexity.

items.q: Do I need technical skills to manage my website after launch?
items.a: Not at all. Every build includes a customized CMS or simple content structure along with direct walkthrough guidance so you can update text, media, and blog posts effortlessly.

items.q: What happens if I need support or updates after the site goes live?
items.a: Every project includes a post-launch support period. I also offer flexible monthly maintenance plans for ongoing technical updates, SEO adjustments, and feature enhancements.
